title: Bardic Melody from the Heart's Cavern (Ka Sur Myllung Na Krem Shadem)
khasi_title: Ka Sur Myllung Na Krem Shadem
cultural_context: Introspective philosophical ballad from Andreas Sun's 2006 work, exploring the inner spiritual temple of the human heart as an altar of truth.

khasi: Ka mih ka sur kaba jar-jar;
Hynrei ka jingshai ba kynja blei;
Hangta nga shem ia la ka mynsiem,
Ba sngap ia ka ktien jong U Blei;
Sur myllung ba pynklet ia ka khuslai,
Ba theh ka jingsuk ba pura.
english: From the deep cavern of the human chest,
There rises a quiet, serene melody;
Untainted by the clatter of the world,
Bearing the sacred light of divinity;
Listening to the gentle voice of God;
A melodious song that banishes earthly worry,

khasi: Haba ka pyrthei ka shon ia nga,
Nga leit sha kane ka krem ba rieh;
U Blei U don hangta ban pyntngen,
Ban ai ka bor ban ieng biang pat;
Kumta to ngin sumar ia la ka dohnud,
Ba kan khuid kum u mawlynnai,
Ba ka sur na krem shadem
english: Whenever worldly tribulations weigh me down,
I retreat into this quiet inner cavern;
God is present there to comfort me,
Imparting renewed strength to rise again;
So let us keep vigil over our hearts,
That they remain pure as clear crystal,
So that the song from within the chest
May echo righteousness throughout all time.

vocabulary.krem shadem: cavern of the chest / inner soul / heart
vocabulary.sur myllung: melodious, poetic song of the bards
